description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractDocumentifier' within the SuiteCRM project. The class provides a base interface and common methods for converting SugarBean objects into document-friendly associative arrays, including utility functions for sanitizing phone numbers and fixing email data. It is designed to be extended by specific Documentifier implementations that handle various object types within the CRM system.

classes.name: AbstractDocumentifier
classes.description: An abstract base class for implementing documentifiers that transform SugarBean objects into array representations suitable for document-oriented databases and JSON serialization. Provides abstract method 'documentify' and common utility methods 'fixPhone', 'fixEmails', and 'sanitizePhone'.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Abstract method intended to convert a SugarBean object into a document-friendly associative array. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: fixPhone
methods.description: Sanitizes phone numbers within a document array by removing non-numeric characters, except '+'.

methods.name: fixEmails
methods.description: Fills the email field in the document array with the primary email address from the associated SugarBean if it's not already set.

methods.name: sanitizePhone
methods.description: Removes all characters except digits and '+' from a phone string to improve search compatibility.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Returns a list of default metadata fields that are always present in a SugarBean, such as creation and modification info.
